description: Utility functions and constants for handling dates, files, themes, and UI interactions in Mattermost's web application, specifically within the channels module.

methods.name: createSafeId
methods.description: Generates a safe string ID from a message descriptor or string by replacing spaces with underscores.

methods.name: isUnhandledLineBreakKeyCombo
methods.description: Checks if a keydown event corresponds to an unhandled line break combination (e.g., Alt/Option + Enter).

methods.name: insertLineBreakFromKeyEvent
methods.description: Inserts a newline at the cursor position in a textbox element, updating the DOM directly.

methods.name: getDateForUnixTicks
methods.description: Converts Unix timestamp in milliseconds to a Date object.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the current Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: getRemainingDaysFromFutureTimestamp
methods.description: Calculates remaining days from today to a future timestamp.

methods.name: addTimeToTimestamp
methods.description: Adds or subtracts a specified amount of time (seconds, minutes, hours, days) to/from a timestamp.

methods.name: isDateWithinDaysRange
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp is within a specified range of days from today, past or future.

methods.name: getLocaleDateFromUTC
methods.description: Formats a UTC timestamp into a localized date string with optional timezone.

methods.name: replaceHtmlEntities
methods.description: Replaces HTML entities (&, <, >) in a string with their character equivalents.

methods.name: isGIFImage
methods.description: Checks if a file extension corresponds to a GIF image.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Determines the file type category based on extension or URL content.

methods.name: getFileIconPath
methods.description: Returns the icon path associated with a file info object based on its extension.

methods.name: getCompassIconClassName
methods.description: Returns CSS class name for file type icons, with options for outline and size.

methods.name: getIconClassName
methods.description: Returns icon class name based on file type string.

methods.name: toTitleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case.

methods.name: toRgbValues
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to RGB comma-separated values.

methods.name: applyTheme
methods.description: Applies a theme object to the UI, updating CSS variables and styles accordingly.
